title: ochna glaucescens
intro: Ochna glaucescens, commonly known as the silver ochna, is a flowering plant species in the family Ochnaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Ochna glaucescens include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory conditions. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that may help to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties.
